# Friends of Lake Henry
 
> Nonprofit organization supporting restoration efforts for Lake Henry in Blair, Wisconsin through fundraising, community events, and an annual raffle.
 
Friends of Lake Henry is a nonprofit dedicated to the restoration of Lake Henry in Blair, WI. The organization raises funds through donations, events, and raffles, recognizes its donors, and documents the lake through a community photo gallery. Raffle winners and live drawings are posted on Facebook.
 
## Pages
 
- [Home](https://friendsoflakehenry.com/): Organization overview and announcements
- [Events](https://friendsoflakehenry.com/events): Upcoming events hosted by the organization
- [Photo Gallery](https://friendsoflakehenry.com/photos): Photos of Lake Henry; community members can submit photos at https://friendsoflakehenry.com/photos/submit
- [Raffle](https://friendsoflakehenry.com/raffle): Current raffle details; winners and live drawings on Facebook
- [Donors](https://friendsoflakehenry.com/donors): Recognition of donors supporting the restoration effort
- [Contact](https://friendsoflakehenry.com/contact): Get in touch with the organizatio
